{
  "name": "vibe-wise",
  "version": "0.1.44",
  "description": "You build. AI writes. Learn how to build software while Codex writes the code.",
  "author": { "name": "Noah Kim" },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/nykooi1/vibe-wise",
  "repository": "https://github.com/nykooi1/vibe-wise",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": ["learning", "architecture", "engineering"],
  "skills": "./skills/",
  "hooks": {},
  "interface": {
    "displayName": "VibeWise",
    "shortDescription": "Learn to build software while Codex writes the code",
    "longDescription": "VibeWise puts learning first. Codex asks for your approach, helps you examine tradeoffs, and explains unfamiliar concepts. You own the design and decide when it's ready; Codex writes the agreed code and explains what it changed.",
    "developerName": "Noah Kim",
    "category": "Developer Tools",
    "capabilities": ["Interactive", "Read", "Write"],
    "websiteURL": "https://github.com/nykooi1/vibe-wise",
    "composerIcon": "./.claude-plugin/icon.svg",
    "logo": "./assets/vibewise-icon.png",
    "defaultPrompt": ["$vibe-wise:learn"],
    "screenshots": []
  }
}
